descriptions.text: Goblin Murder Dozer. Contraption. A goblin-built, steam-powered machine designed to mow down and slaughter unsuspecting dungeon crawlers. I hope you’re up to date with your tetanus shots.

recap.text: Carl steps into a pitch-black alley, and three lights snap on over the Goblin Murder Dozer: rusting metal on treads, a spiked wheel, three goblins aboard, the driver in a kitchen pot. He kills one goblin outside the Tutorial Guild door, then climbs the dozer, throws a goblin onto the blades and clobbers the driver off with the pot. With twelve seconds left on the boiler, he runs back and slams the door, which holds.

Carl blows the roof with poleaxes, charges he designed on the previous floor to breach through a building's floors without levelling it. They blast up and down in a cone and never sideways. The design came from his quest for focused explosives. He has not seen one executed perfectly since the murder dozer's first blast on the first floor.

beats.headline: Fall into an obvious trap
beats.text: Carl steps into a pitch-black alley and an achievement tells him what he has done. Three lights snap on, a steam engine roars, and he runs, both pink Crocs flying. The machine rockets out, nearly hits the far wall and turns to face him: rusting metal on treads, a spiked wheel whirring, three goblins on top, the driver in a kitchen pot. It sticks on a corner, two goblins jump off after him, and at a door marked Tutorial Guild he punches one down and kills it. The door opens and he rushes inside as the dozer barrels past, rolling over the corpse, and slams it on the two goblins left aboard.
beats.gist: Carl steps into a pitch-black alley and runs from the Murder Dozer, which flattens a goblin corpse.

beats.headline: Boarded from behind
beats.text: Carl goes back out. The dozer has overshot the door and driven into the wall, its spikes shredding sparks off the stone. He climbs a small ladder of bones tied with rope that rips his bare feet. The top is a fur-lined recessed hole with benches for about fifteen goblins, almost hot enough to burn. He throws one goblin over the driver's head onto the spinning blades, snatches the kitchen pot off the driver's head and clobbers him off the side with it, then jumps down on him feet first. Goblin Murder Dozer, Boiler Breach Imminent: twelve seconds. He runs.
beats.gist: Carl boards the dozer, clobbers its driver with a kitchen pot, and runs before the boiler breaches.

beats.headline: A focused blast
beats.text: Carl makes the guild door and slams it. The world shakes and the door bucks him onto the floor, but it holds. Mordecai says that gate could hold back a kinetic strike from a star destroyer, and he has never seen anything shake it that much. A boiler breach, then. The local shaman probably enchanted the machine to focus the blast at the closest non-goblin if it ever exploded, and a focused explosion, even a small one, has a lot more energy than you might think.
beats.gist: Mordecai says the guild door could withstand a star destroyer's kinetic strike, yet the blast shakes it.

beats.headline: Still the model
beats.text: Carl blows the roof with poleaxes, charges he designed on the previous floor to breach through a building's floors without levelling it, blasting up and down in a cone and never sideways. The whole idea came from his quest for focused explosives, something he has not seen perfectly executed since that very first blast of the murder dozer on the first floor.
beats.gist: Carl blows the roof with poleaxes, charges that blast up and down in a cone, never sideways.

relations.note: it was set to run him down
